item.title: Episode 9: Brain Injury Service Provision – Broken pathways
item.description: Released: 16/08/2024One person is admitted to hospital with a brain injury every 90 seconds within the UK which equates to approximately 977 admissions to hospital a day. More and more people are surviving brain injuries due to advances in acute medicine but this means more needs to be done so these people can access ongoing community neurorehabilitation to optimise their recovery and reduce the longer term societal impacts.
